_about: The one list of hoi4-imagegen family ids. .tools/audits/audit_shelf.py checks that profiles.json, the shelf catalog and the shelf builder input name exactly these 40 families (profile row aliases, shelf sub-folders and families without a shelf are listed below), and hoi4-imagegen's CI should read the same list so the two projects cannot drift.

families_without_shelf.gui_texture: no vanilla canvas to measure; vanilla GUI windows are in interface/vanilla
families_without_shelf.super_event: a mod pattern with no vanilla texture
